page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then a block of verse lines in the centre (a hymn stanza set, then a heading TRACTUS. and a second verse block). No columns, no margin notes, no footer text except a stray mark at the bottom right.

main_text.head: AD GABRIELEM ARCHANGELUM. Graduale.
main_text.l: Et fac eos ad vitam celeres.
main_text.head: TRACTUS.

page.notes: Running head and heading are set in small capitals; the heading "Graduale" and "TRACTUS." are reproduced as printed. Long s rendered as s. Stray mark "Ex" at lower right is a printer's signature-like mark, not transcribed as text. Some words in the scan are faint and were read with care; "pauperes" carries a long-s form in the printing and is given as printed.
